security.title: Security - MNSCloud
security.heading: Security is a control-plane responsibility.
security.lead: MNSCloud public clients and connectors are designed to be auditable. They do not carry server-side secrets, permanent provider credentials, database credentials, or hidden authorization bypasses.

cards.title: API authority
cards.text: Authorization, tenant scope, billing, policy, routing ownership, and secrets remain API-side.

cards.title: Outbound agents
cards.text: Remote management flows are initiated by agents to the API, reducing exposed management ports.

cards.title: Public boundary
cards.text: Public repositories use placeholders and documented contracts, not customer data or private topology.

security.ctaTitle: Review security posture before exposing infrastructure.

contact.title: Contact - MNSCloud
contact.heading: Talk to MNSCloud.
contact.lead: Use this page as the public contact entry point. The production version can later submit demo requests to a safe public API endpoint.
